rationale: BLOCKED, no firm leaning. I read the complete held EO 13266 (67 FR 42467, June 20, 2002, Activities To Promote Personal Fitness): sec. 1 findings; sec. 2(a) directs named Secretaries and the ONDCP Director to review their personal-fitness programs and modify or add policies; sec. 2(b) requires a report within 90 days (a spent one-time duty); sec. 2(c) creates the Personal Fitness Interagency Working Group chaired by HHS that meets at least twice a year (continuing); sec. 3 is the internal-management disclaimer. It has no sunset, no revocation and no savings clause. The only history observation is an empty catalog note, and the U.S. Code lead prints the order as a note without an ending statement but only as an unheld pointer checked through 2026-10-09. A 2002 working group of this kind could easily have gone dormant or been replaced, and nothing held shows either, so neither status is supportable.
